Morning Brief
Nifty 50 rose 1.85% to 25,819 but decliners led 1,550 to 1,010
Today’s read
The biggest names carried the session. The fifty most traded stocks returned +1.27% weighted by turnover, against -0.48% for the median stock, a gap of 1.8 percentage points, so most stocks did worse than the busiest names suggest.

APL Apollo Tubes Limited fell 11.6% on 72 times its usual volume. Its exchange filing that session was about guidance or investor update, “Link of Recording”.

Jupiter Life Line Hospitals Limited rose 3.5% on 138 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Carlyle pares 7.4% stake in Piramal Pharma for over Rs 2,211 crore”.

Thomas Cook (India) Limited rose 15.6% on 171 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Thomas Cook shares rally 14%, soar 62% in a month; what's driving gains?”.

Jupiter Wagons Limited rose 20.0% on 68 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Railway stock: Jupiter Wagons climbs 12% after 8-day fall on JV with Woojin”.

Carlyle pares 7.4% stake in Piramal Pharma for over Rs 2,211 crore
Carlyle sold a 7.4% stake in Piramal Pharma for Rs 2,211 crore at Rs 224.17 per share through open-market blocks, cutting its holding to 10.52%. Domestic institutions absorbed the supply. While the transaction broadens the institutional shareholder base, Carlyle's remaining double-digit stake maintains a secondary supply overhang that caps near-term valuation multiples until fully cleared.

Thomas Cook shares rally 14%, soar 62% in a month; what's driving gains?
Thomas Cook India rose 14%, extending a monthly advance to 62% despite a flat benchmark index. Operating leverage is driving the re-rating as post-restructuring overheads remain lean while outbound leisure and corporate travel volumes rebound. Sustaining these valuation gains requires operating margins in the foreign exchange and travel services segments to hold through the coming peak holiday booking quarter.

Railway stock: Jupiter Wagons climbs 12% after 8-day fall on JV with Woojin
Jupiter Wagons formed a joint venture with South Korea's Woojin Industrial Systems to manufacture metro trainsets and electrical propulsion equipment locally. The partnership broadens the company's addressable market beyond freight rolling stock into higher-value municipal passenger rail. This diversifies revenue away from Indian Railways wagon procurement cycles and pits Jupiter directly against BEML and Titagarh Rail Systems in upcoming urban metro tenders.

Nvidia stock loses momentum after Huang's return as CEO, down another 9%; why are investors dumping AI stocks again?
Nvidia dropped 9%, extending a two-day slide to 14.5% as markets reassessed returns on massive artificial intelligence infrastructure spending. For Indian equities, this de-rating softens foreign portfolio risk appetite and signals caution on enterprise software budgets. The Directorate General of Foreign Trade allocated 8,606 tonnes of raw cane sugar to the US under preferential quotas for fiscal 2027. The volume represents less than 0.03 percent of India's annual production, making the revenue impact immaterial for listed millers like Balrampur Chini Mills. The insurer's next quarterly earnings report will show whether operational continuity and margin targets remain intact.

Parent entity LG Electronics Inc. will sell 13.58 million shares, representing a 2% stake in LG Electronics India, via block deals at a floor price of ₹1,709.30 per share to raise ₹2,320.5 crore. Volatility-weary US investors side swiped as tariff mayhem adds to tech pain
The US proposed new country-specific tariffs on 14 trading partners, including India, alongside an additional 20% levy on Chinese goods. Higher duties directly threaten export volumes and operating margins for Indian textile, pharmaceutical, and auto-ancillary exporters selling to North America. Furthermore, trade tension typically strengthens the US dollar, pressuring the rupee and prompting foreign institutional outflows from Indian equities.

Why Huawei convicted in US? How its Iran business triggered 7-yr legal battle - what it means for China’s tech goals
A US court convicted Huawei on 10 criminal counts involving bank fraud and sanctions violations linked to its business in Iran. This verdict has no fresh impact on Indian equities because Indian telecom operators like Bharti Airtel and Reliance Jio have already excluded Chinese vendors from their 5G network rollouts under national security rules.

Gold price prediction: Despite 27% decline from January peak, UBS still retains ₹1.50 lakh/10 gram target for 2027

Higher long-term bullion prices widen the loan-to-value cushion for gold loan NBFCs like Muthoot Finance, supporting AUM growth. Conversely, persistent high prices compress volume growth for jewellery retailers like Titan and Kalyan Jewellers, while expanding India's trade deficit.
